title: Exact variance-to-influence ratio
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^3\to\mathbb R$ be defined by $f(x)=\frac{t+1}{4}+\frac{t}{4}x_1+\frac{t}{4}x_2-\frac14x_0x_1+\frac14x_0x_2+\frac{t-1}{4}x_1x_2$, where $t=2+\frac{\sqrt{33}}{3}$. Equip the sign cube with the uniform product probability distribution, and let $T$ be the decision tree that first queries coordinate $0$; if $x_0=-1$, it queries coordinate $1$ and, unless $x_1=-1$, then queries coordinate $2$; if $x_0=1$, it queries coordinate $2$ and, unless $x_2=-1$, then queries coordinate $1$. Then the variance of $f$ divided by the sum, over the three coordinates $i$, of the probability that $T$ queries $i$ times the influence of coordinate $i$ on $f$ is $\frac{42+2\sqrt{33}}{51}$.
